headline: Opinion: CHOOSE Act will further hurt Alabama's public schools
snippet: AEA found bipartisan voter opposition to unlimited voucher funding.

headline: Alabama lawmakers have approved a school choice program
snippet: Senate voted 23-9. Opposition from Democrats warning of harm to public education.

headline: Alabama House passes school voucher-like program
snippet: CHOOSE Act passed 69-34, creating ESAs up to $7K for private school, $2K for homeschool.

headline: Alabama leads the nation in educational freedom in 2024
snippet: Ivey signed CHOOSE Act in March 2024. Eligibility starts below 300% poverty, universal by 2027.
